data.headline: Everything AI 2026
data.sub: 684 AI tools, models and guides, sorted by the job you’re doing
data.image_alt: Cover of Everything AI 2026 by Elvin Peters

paras: You have a job to do with AI and no idea which of the hundreds of tools to try. Everything AI 2026 holds 684 AI resources in 28 tabs, so you open the tab for your job and start with the Picks. You do not search a list sorted by name.
A resource is an AI tool, model, dataset, course or guide. Each carries a level, and 246 of the 684 are labelled Beginner, 224 Intermediate and 214 Developer.

paras: For 79 paid tools it also shows plan names and prices, read from the vendor’s pricing page on that date. Three of the 79 come from price trackers, and they are marked.

data.heading: Why you can trust the links
paras: AI tools change names, owners and addresses often. Testing every link on October 29, 2026 turned up 30 notable changes, and the guide logs each one. Windsurf is now Devin Desktop. Play.ht has closed. Everything AI 2026 is a snapshot as of that date.

data.heading: What it is not
paras: It is not every AI tool. An entry goes in only if it is about AI, its link works, it has shipped or posted in the last 12 months, its job can be stated in one line, and its pricing is public or it has a free tier. No vendor paid to be listed or to get a Pick, and no link carries an affiliate code.
Prices change, so confirm on the vendor’s site before you pay.

data.heading: What you get
paras:
• A spreadsheet (.xlsx) that opens in Excel and Google Sheets. Filter it by level, cost or tab.
  • A PDF field guide that explains how the list is organised and how to choose.

data.heading: Who made it
paras: Elvin Peters wrote The Artificial Advantage, a book on working with AI, and ran paid media for two regulated brands at goeasy, a Canadian consumer lender. The Picks follow the written entry rules above, and no one paid for them.

data.heading: The free Vault
paras: The free AI Resource Vault is a separate list that stays free. Everything AI 2026 is AI only and sorted by job, and 565 of its 684 entries are new beyond the free Vault. The other 119 are in both, and each was re-checked and rewritten.
